nodes.name: test_roles.py
nodes.summary: Tests role resolution (owner, leader, basic) per group and the minimum role required for each bot command, plus role hierarchy checks.

nodes.name: test_schedule_tool.py
nodes.summary: Async tests for the schedule web tools: base URL normalization, registration only with an API key, bearer-auth requests, and error propagation to the model via a mocked httpx transport.

nodes.name: test_storage.py
nodes.summary: Tests for JSON/JSONL file stores, group, seen, history and usage stores, corruption recovery, surrogate handling and the single-instance process lock.

nodes.name: test_text_and_models.py
nodes.summary: Tests message splitting by UTF-16 length, plain-text conversion, owner command parsing, and Zalo update parsing and dedupe keys.

nodes.name: test_updater.py
nodes.summary: Tests the git-based auto-updater: pulling new commits, reporting local-change conflicts, and unavailability for exe or non-git installs.

nodes.name: test_vps_supervisor.py
nodes.summary: Tests supervisor selection, standby gating, systemd start/stop via sudo systemctl, failure reporting, and the admin API server-info endpoint without secrets.

nodes.name: _example.py
nodes.summary: Example custom tool template (not loaded due to underscore prefix) defining a current_time tool returning Vietnam time.

nodes.name: SYSTEM.md
nodes.summary: System prompt in Vietnamese defining the assistant role, plain-text reply style for Zalo, and safety limits against prompt injection and secret disclosure.
